title: Selected work
intro: Eight bold months, a yellow house, and more finished canvases than anyone expected. This corridor holds mine.
cue: Keep scrolling — the gallery runs sideways

works.title: On-Demand Mechanic
works.note: The first thing I designed where the hard part was the waiting, not the booking.
works.description: A live-tracking app for on-demand car repair: request a mechanic, watch them arrive, follow the job through to handover. Most of the design work sits in the states between those moments.
works.outcome: A full booking-to-handover flow, with the tracking and workflow screens carried through to high fidelity.
works.alt: Mobile app screens for an on-demand mechanic service, showing a live map with a technician en route and a job status timeline.

works.title: PlaySync
works.note: Brackets are a data structure before they are a screen. I drew the structure first.
works.description: A tournament management interface: fixtures, brackets, scores and the running order, built so an organiser can update it from the side of a pitch rather than a desk.
works.outcome: A connected set of organiser and player screens covering setup, live scoring and standings.
works.alt: Tournament management app screens showing a fixture bracket, a live score card and a standings table.

works.title: Red Bull Poster
works.note: An interface has a second chance to explain itself. A poster gets one.
works.description: A promotional poster study for Red Bull — an unbriefed exercise in composition, energy and making a single image carry the whole message.
works.outcome: A finished key visual, built for social and print crops.
works.alt: A high-energy promotional poster composition in bold colour, built around a single central product image.

works.title: Google-Themed Portfolio
works.note: Designing my own portfolio taught me how badly I wanted someone else to brief me.
works.description: A personal portfolio concept built on Google's visual language — a search-page conceit used as a way of navigating my own work rather than as decoration.
works.outcome: A complete design concept, published while still in progress.
works.alt: A portfolio site concept styled after a Google search results page, with work listed as search results.

works.title: Image Generation UI
works.note: The interesting problem was not the output. It was giving someone a way to steer.
works.description: An interface for text-to-image generation: writing the prompt, adjusting it, and comparing what comes back — designed around iteration rather than a single lucky result.
works.outcome: Prompt, generation and comparison screens, taken through to high fidelity.
works.alt: An AI image generation interface showing a prompt field, generation settings and a grid of resulting images.

works.title: Weather App UI
works.note: The first thing I ever published. I can see every seam, and I am leaving it up.
works.description: A weather interface built around the forecast rather than the current temperature — the question people are usually actually asking.
works.outcome: My first published project, and the one everything after it was measured against.
works.alt: A mobile weather app interface showing current conditions above an hourly and weekly forecast.
